Crescent Lake.
guide_solution: (a) Substances called acids have a sharp taste known as acidity. (b) Ordinary rain water is slightly acidic. (c) But rain can be very acidic in severely polluted areas. (d) There is a link between acid rain and damage to human health. (e) Many world famous buildings are at risk due to severe acid rain.
